question: Can the s048b per-epoch C_t survival sweep be turned into a browseable, animated 3D viewer of cloud evolution with truth-q overlay?
narrative_md: Built a single-user Flask cloud-evolution viewer that animates the per-epoch C_t survival cloud with truth-q (green), closest candidate (yellow), and killed-haze, plus synchronised satellite-mesh / omega-direction-sphere / |omega|(t) side panels. Lifted primitives into lib.c_t_pipeline byte-equivalent to s048b (0 mismatches). A tool, not an experiment -- no inversion result. Overlays cached truth-q per frame, so it reads truth as input.
